reasoning: This checkout implements the TrustyAI Service, a Python REST API built with FastAPI and Hypercorn. The application defines HTTP routers for inference consumption, data upload, health, explainability, fairness, and drift metrics; runs a background Prometheus metrics scheduler; and is packaged in a container whose command launches trustyai_service.main. It is therefore an independently deployed runtime service rather than an operator, library, or configuration-only project.
